errors.text: The predicted sign is opposite to the target result: it predicts greater than 10% suppression, whereas the target reports an approximately 12% increase in lattice thermal conductivity.

The proposed mechanism assumes SRO is primarily an additional phonon-scattering source and omits the target mechanisms of reduced lattice distortion and high-conductivity percolation through HfTi and TiZr ordered clusters.
The cited evidence establishes SRO, segregation, or effects on dislocation mobility but does not provide evidence that SRO suppresses phonon or lattice thermal transport.
The hypothesis substitutes W-Ta-Cr-V-Hf or MoNbTaW systems for the target bcc HfNbTaTiZr alloy and does not reconstruct its B2-like ordered structures or percolative pathways.
